klipler.istem: Slow push-in toward the cracked shell, light shimmers softly on the glossy shell, water droplets glint. The snail stays completely still, its tentacles keep their shape and number, nothing new appears, 3D animation style preserved.
Gentle ripples move across the pond, golden light sparkles on the water, lily pads sway slightly, mist drifts. Slow camera glide forward. 3D animation style preserved.
